cpu_tests.environment: Local Ubuntu under WSL, Python 3.12.3, g++
cpu_tests.command: PYTHONPATH=src Q6_REQUIRE_CPP=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v

packaging_scope: Only selected source, documentation, notices and allowlisted historical numeric results; no weights, credentials, original server logs or compiled binaries

original_service.remote_actions: read-only source snapshot and service/config fingerprint checks

not_performed: full-model startup from the new package
new inference or load tests against the original service
limitations: Original deployment measurements are not verification of the repackaged Docker recipe. First deployment requires the documented GPU acceptance checks.
